name: The Assault of Gallus, 66 AD - Introductory Scenario

game.night_cite: card turn track shades 8-10; victory conditions: 'played for ten turns (only the first seven of which may be day turns)'
game.opening_cite: card: 'The game begins with a Roman Fire Phase (4.12)'

deployment.cite: card: Judaeans set up first inside the New City on or within its outer walls; Romans set up second anywhere outside Jerusalem no closer than five hexes from any Elevated Hex after observing the Judaean deployment
deployment.min_force_cite: special rule 1: >= 1 unit in each Bastion and Fortress of the North Wall O50..QQ29 inclusive (Forts count: 'Fortresses and Forts are considered identical' [2.11]); requirement void from the start of turn 4; a hex vacated by combat results need not be reoccupied
deployment.roman_prohibited_cite: card: Roman entry of Garrison Areas is not allowed (e.g., Romans may never enter P50 or QQ32)

playable_area.note: playable = New City crescent + the outside region (flood fill from A25, barred by Elevated hexes and the crescent, and by the two southern_bound diagonals) + every Elevated hex bordering that ground. The bound's anchors are the card's own arc ends: 'The scenario is played only on the North Wall from O50 to Women's Gate to QQ31' - west flank capped at O50's printed number (50), east flank at the QQ31/QQ32 junction (32). The Old City south of the Second Wall is OFF the battlefield and its terrain is deliberately unencoded (A4 hard bound, Bruce's ruling 2026-08-09; leak evidence = ingest/builtup_evidence.json, 219 reachable Old City art hexes typed clear pre-bound). Routed/Panicked units whose Refuge path leaves the battlefield exit at the south gates and are removed from play (Bruce-approved scope call 2026-08-07; flagged for module-author expert review).

reinforcement.cite: special rule 2: from turn 4, at the start of the Judaean MPh roll the dice and randomly draw that many units plus the Giora Leader from the South Wall force; odd entry roll = Tadi Gate (OO33), even = Q49; if blocked, enter at the other Gate; repeat each turn until all have entered. Count = two dice per source-defect entry 'gallus-reinforcement-dice-count' (declared interpretation, expert review pending).

vp.cite: special rule 3: Romans win if they control (18.3) ten Built-up hexes at the end of any Judaean Melee Phase; hex control = last occupant [18.3]; Judaeans win by avoiding the Roman victory conditions through turn 10 (or Roman concession)

oob_cite: printed scenario card (module board Intro.jpg) - counts byte-verified identical to the module's Gallus .vsav force pool (ingest/gallus_oob.json); 'The Giora Faction and two Zealots are removed temporarily as the garrison of the South Wall'

enforced: [2.14] letter-diagonal grid identity (validated on 3,071 module region names)
Deployment: Judaeans first in the New City / on its outer walls; minimum-force strongpoints O50..QQ29; Romans outside, >= 5 hexes from any Elevated hex, after seeing the Judaean setup (card)

[TEC] per-class movement costs: Clear/Slope/Built-up (Judaean 2 / Roman 3 [8.95]); wall entry only via Staircase hexside, Breach, Gate or connected Elevated [8.91-8.93]; siege-engine and cavalry terrain prohibitions
[6.x] stacking limits at phase end, per terrain, per side; Artillery/HQ/SE free-stack with one-each cap

[7.x] zones of control: ground/gate/elevated ZOC classes, hard-ZOC entry stop, 7.311 exit rule + Judaean freeze in Roman Heavy-Infantry ground ZOC (per the 1/6/1992 official Q&A ruling), soft ZOC +3 MF for HQ/Cavalry, no ZOC at night
[4.x] phase sequence Rally-Fire-Movement-Melee per side; game opens with the Roman Fire Phase; turns 8-10 are night
Reinforcement: Giora faction dice-rolled entry from turn 4 at OO33/Q49 (declared two-dice count - see source_defects)
[18.3] hex control tracking + the ten-Built-up-hex Roman victory check at the end of each Judaean Melee Phase
enforced_tier2: [11.x, 14.x] Melee Table with drm/strength modifiers, loss choice, retreats, continuous combat, advance after combat
[9.x, 13.x] Missile Table: fire concentration, attack multiples, LOF, mandatory targets, wall attack bonus
[10.1, 12.x] Ram/Armored Tower breach attacks, breach damage accumulation, breach state
[15.x, 16.x, 17.x] disruption ladder Fresh-Disrupted-Routed-Panicked, rally table with drm, rout/panic movement
umpired: [6.5, 8.7, 11.6] Escalades - not available in v1 (players adjudicate; v1.1 with module-author review)
[6.6, 8.8, 16.4] Testudo formation - not available in v1

[2.45, 8.6] Siege-engine FACING is not enforced (breach attacks allowed vs any adjacent Elevated hex); pushing crews are checked at the moving/attacking moment, and crews move as separate units rather than a locked stack
[8.61] riding atop Towers / tower boarding - not available in v1
[11.86] advance after combat is limited to the vacated hex (excess-E extra advance not offered)
[15.3, 17.21] Routed/Panicked movement: direction toward Refuge is enforced; the full-MF obligation and panicked-move-last ordering are advisory in v1
[5.2] Command Control tracing uses hex-passability BFS (documented approximation)
[9.51, 9.52] LOF elevation adjacency and Crest cases approximated by the crossed-hex obstacle rule (no Crest hexsides in the primary battlefield)
[8.4] artillery movement uses the reverse-side MA directly (the Fresh/Disrupted flip bookkeeping is implicit)
interior roads (not encoded in v1 - module-author verification pending; TEC road rate not applied)
rulings: Official Q&A (The General Question Box + 1/6/1992 AH typescript) is the authority tier above the rulebook text; the two documents AGREE everywhere (decode-prep 6, item by item) - their one discrepancy is a rule-citation mismatch (17.23 vs 17.3) registered in source_defects

Bounded battlefield: the old city beyond the Second Wall is out of play; Routed/Panicked units exiting via the south gates toward Refuge are removed from play (scenario scope statement; Bruce-approved; module-author review pending)
